title: 第12章 茶艺大师、风暴，初次相遇
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这就是我要带你来的地方，我的超级七人塔！”

阿祖的语气中满是自豪感，仿佛那几个‘沃特国际’的拼写字母真的不存在一般。

“怎么样儿子，她很漂亮吧。”

“走，我带你进入看看，你会喜欢这里的。”

莱恩并未动身。

他表现得有些走神，情绪只酝酿了一下便脱口而出道：“爸爸，你没有伤害妈妈吧？”

阿祖怔在当场。

其实莱恩有百分之九十九的把握，祖国人绝不会伤害他的母亲贝卡。

一个多月的相处时间，足够他给阿祖打上的补丁留下深刻记忆。

那就是贝卡对他很重要！

如果阿祖真的有他表现出来的那么喜爱自己，那他就一定会在意自己的感受。

“哈哈，我，我怎么会伤害你的母亲呢。”

“虽然我们的感情现在不是那么好，但我可是超级英雄祖国人，对吧儿子。”

“嗯。”

莱恩心里想着幸好此时的阿祖还未黑化，不然他可没把握这么做。

突然提出要出去飞一圈，傻子都知道有异常。

这也是阿祖会第一时间赶来的原因。

同时，莱恩情绪再一次低落地问道：“爸爸，妈妈她说你是坏人？”

“你信吗，儿子？”

“我，我不知道，但我知道你是我的爸爸，你对我很好很好，我不想离开你。”

莱恩眨眨眼，眼眶有些红了。

他的演技一如既往的在线。

他望向阿祖：“你会一直都对我好的，对吗？如果你做坏事，我也一定会阻止你的！”

“噢，儿子……”

阿祖动容地呼唤一声。

莱恩飞过去主动进行拥抱：“爸爸，我才不会去认那个凶巴巴的不认识的男人做爸爸。”

“我只有一个父亲，那就是你！”

阿祖感动到几乎落泪。

他怀抱住身前小小的身体，血脉传递的羁绊在这一刻几乎达到顶峰。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"This is where I'm going to take you, my Super Seven Towers!"

Azu's tone was full of pride, as if those letters spelling out 'Walter International' really didn't exist.

"How about it, son? She is beautiful."

"Come on, I'll take you in and have a look. You'll like it here."

Lane didn't move.

He seemed a little distracted, and his emotions only brewed for a moment before he blurted out: "Dad, you didn't hurt mom, right?"

Azu was stunned on the spot.

In fact, Ryan was 99% sure that people from the motherland would never harm his mother, Beka.

More than a month of time together was enough for him to leave a deep memory of the patch he put on Azu.

That's why Beca is very important to him!

If Azu really loves himself as much as he shows, then he will definitely care about his feelings.

"Haha, I, how could I hurt your mother?"

"Although our relationship is not that good now, I am a superhero from the motherland, right son."

"Yeah."

Ryan thought to himself that it was fortunate that Azu had not turned black at this time, otherwise he would not be sure to do this.

If he suddenly proposed to go out for a flight, even a fool would know that something was wrong.

This is also the reason why Azu rushed over as soon as possible.

At the same time, Ryan once again asked in a low mood: "Dad, mom, did she say you are a bad person?"

"Do you believe it, son?"

"I, I don't know, but I know you are my dad. You are very good to me. I don't want to leave you."

Ryan blinked, his eyes turning red.

His acting skills are as good as ever.

He looked at Azu: "You will always be nice to me, right? If you do bad things, I will definitely stop you!"

"Oh, son..."

Azu called out movingly.

Ryan flew over and hugged him actively: "Dad, I will not accept that fierce and unknown man as my father."

"I only have one father, and that's you!"

Azu was so moved that he almost cried.

He embraced the small body in front of him, and the bond transmitted by blood almost reached its peak at this moment.
